# Supplier qualification form

Status: template. Complete one record per legal supplier and supply lane. Do not approve from a trading name or price list alone.

| Field | Response/evidence |
|---|---|
| Record ID, owner and review date | |
| Legal supplier, registration and verified address | |
| Manufacturer/distributor relationship | |
| Contact identity and bank verification method | |
| Authorisations/licences relevant to actual products/activity | |
| Dispatch countries, premises and subcontractors | |
| Destination and online-channel resale permissions | |
| Our role and upstream manufacturer/UKRP/importer roles | |
| Product identifiers, declarations, certificates and expiry | |
| Authenticity/lot/serial traceability | |
| Images, data, IFU and translation permissions | |
| Prices, currency, tiers, rebates and quote validity | |
| MOQ, case quantities and order multiples | |
| Payment, deposits and credit terms | |
| Incoterm and named place; customs declarant | |
| Origin evidence, tariff codes and import cost assumptions | |
| Lead times, actual stock location and feed freshness | |
| Allocation/backorder/substitution policy | |
| Minimum remaining shelf life and rejection rules | |
| Storage and transport requirements | |
| Direct-ship tracking and lot/serial reporting | |
| Faults, returns, warranty, service and spare parts | |
| Complaint/recall notification and cooperation | |
| Change control and document renewal obligations | |
| Liability, insurance and audit rights | |
| Data processing and customer information access | |
| Business continuity and alternative supply | |
| Open discrepancies and deadline | |
| Compliance decision and rationale | |
| Commercial decision and rationale | |
| Approved categories/lanes and next review | |

Attach sources in controlled project storage. Approval should identify who reviewed what and when. An unresolved authenticity or lawful-supply issue blocks release regardless of commercial score.
